_note: What you see: A decision outside a meeting: the members consent in writing, with the tally, the required unanimity and the closing time.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Een besluit buiten vergadering: de leden stemmen schriftelijk in, met de stand, de vereiste unanimiteit en de sluitingstijd.
Raad van toezicht Zuiddrecht Sport · bui: Supervisory board Zuiddrecht Sport · outside a meeting
Unanimiteit is vereist. Zonder reactie v: Unanimity is required. Without a response from Inge Mulder before 15 October 17:00 the proposal lapses and goes to the next meeting.
De raad van toezicht stemt in met de tar: The supervisory board consents to the sports hall rates for 2027: a rise of 3,2 percent for clubs and 4 percent for commercial hire, as proposed by the managing director.
Please put the 2028 rates on the agenda separately.
